raw_text: Regarding the 'PLA Andaman invasion plan' — I've seen this floating around and it deserves scrutiny. The Type 075 numbers are accurate (3 commissioned) and the J-20 range from Hainan to Andamans is technically feasible with tanker support. But something about the writing style feels off. The 'Turn 7' reference in some versions suggests this might be from a game. Has anyone traced the original source?
clean_text: Naval analyst notes PLA Andaman invasion details are technically accurate but writing style seems off. References to Turn 7 suggest possible game origin. Asks for original source tracing.
